points.statement: The work seeks to create an efficient and effective model for restoring medical images.
points.quote: We aim to build an efficient and effective model for medical image restoration based on the Receptance Weighted Key Value (RWKV) peng2023rwkv, termed Restore-RWKV.

points.statement: The authors introduce a recurrent attention mechanism that captures global dependencies while maintaining linear computational complexity.
points.quote: First, we present a recurrent WKV (Re-WKV) attention mechanism that captures global dependencies with linear computational complexity.

points.statement: They develop an omnidirectional token shift layer that improves local dependencies by shifting tokens from every direction across a broad context.
points.quote: Second, we develop an omnidirectional token shift (Omni-Shift) layer that enhances local dependencies by shifting tokens from all directions and across a wide context range.

points.statement: The adaptations produce an efficient and effective model for medical image restoration.
points.quote: These adaptations make the proposed Restore-RWKV an efficient and effective model for medical image restoration.
